messages:
Maya L.: Quick preflight — are we aligned on what evidence we need from KMS/HSM side for the ISO run next Wed? I have an auditor question about HSM attestations.

Omar K.: We need: key rotation policy docs, HSM attestation logs (last 6 months), access matrix, and the provisioning workflow. I'll attach PR for rotation playbook.

Maya L.: @Omar K. can you own getting the rotation playbook into centralized evidence bucket? Also who is owning the HSM attestation export?

Omar K.: I can take playbook -> bucket. HSM attestation export: Jin, is that something you can run on staging HSM and push artifacts?

Jin W.: Yep, can do. Need a small window — HSM vendor tool runs ~30m and will lock signing service. Tentative schedule Thu 10–11am PT. Is that ok for ops?

Priya R.: Ops can take the 10–11 slot, but we'll need a short rollback plan. Also adding incident contact: pager oncall and sec oncall.

Maya L.: Great. @ops-bot can you add event to compliance calendar and tag the evidence bucket?

ops-bot: calendar: compliance: Added event "HSM attestation export" Thu 10:00–11:00 PT. Evidence bucket: compliance-evidence/staging/kms/attestations created. :white_check_mark:

Omar K.: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — rotation playbook draft. Assigning @Maya L. and @Priya R. for review.

Maya L.: Reviewing now. Quick nit: add sample log snippet showing attestation fields (nonce, cert chain). e.g.

```json
{
  "attestation": {
    "nonce": "base64..",
    "cert_chain": ["-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----", "..."]
  }
}
```

Jin W.: For the export I'll run:
curl -X POST "https://hsm-staging.local/export" -H "Authorization: Bearer $HSM_TOKEN" -o attest-2026-03-19.json
Will push to bucket via gsutil cp.

Priya R.: I'll create the rollback playbook doc in ops-runbooks and link it in the PR.

Maya L.: Final ask: security team needs proof of KMS key wrapping for backup keys. Omar — can you confirm the backup flow uses KMS wrap/unwrap and capture config?

Omar K.: Confirmed. I'll add wiring diagram + sample config snippet to the PR before EOD.

Priya R.: I'll ping reviews at 09:30 tomorrow. If anyone can't make Thu window, call it out now.

Jin W.: All good for Thu. Thanks.

Maya L.: OK closing loop — thanks all. We'll mark owner fields in the ticket. :+1:
